    r = f["return_distance"]
    g = f["regret"]

    cd = f["cluster_density"]

    # Nonlinear correction: penalize large distances quadratically
    # but keep bounded by using d + 0.3*d^2

    # Return weight increases with progress for closure
    return_w = 0.15 + 0.35 * p
    # Regret weight decays with progress
    regret_w = 0.30 - 0.10 * p
    # Cluster density term early
    cluster_term = 0.08 * (1-p) * cd
    # Regret scaled by inverse of nearest_remaining to emphasize dense candidates
    regret_scaled = regret_w * g / (1 + nr)
    return -dist_term + return_w * r + regret_scaled + cluster_term
